newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria opens airport in southern gas area.
newsitem.headline: Algeria opens airport in southern gas area.

text.p: An airport began operating this week in Algeria's southern Hassi-R'Mel gas-producing area to transport gas workers following attacks by Moslem guerrillas, the official Algerian news agency APS said on Wednesday.
A dozen gas and oil workers have been killed in guerrilla ambushes in the past three years as they travelled by road.
Two oil workers were killed last month a day after Moslem rebels slaughtered more than 30 people at a roadblock some 100 km (60 miles) north of Hassi-R'Mel where the main gas field lies.
More than 50,000 people have been killed since early 1992 when the authorities cancelled a general election in which radical Islamists had taken a commanding lead.
